roundingStepMinor.label: Round "% off" pack prices to (in paisa)
roundingStepMinor.help: A pack priced as a share off the regular total is rounded to this step. 1000 = to the nearest 10 taka.

rounding.label: Which way to round
rounding.help: Down: the customer never pays more than the share promises. Nearest or up are also possible.

maxPairsPerRule.label: Most combos one rule may make
maxPairsPerRule.help: A safety limit: a rule that would make more stops here and says so on its card.

salesDays.label: Best sellers count the sales of the last (days)
salesDays.help: The "best sellers first" order of the generated combos counts orders from this many days back.

newColourDays.label: "New colour" tag shows for (days)
newColourDays.help: A combo with a colour added in the last days carries the tag on its card.

seasons.label: Season tabs on the combo hub
seasons.help: The seasons a combo rule can be listed under.

list.label: Combo category page (shop default)
list.help: The design of a combo rule's page when the rule does not choose its own.

page.label: Combo product page (shop default)
page.help: The design of one combo's page when the rule does not choose its own.

bag.label: Combo in the bag (shop default)
bag.help: How a set shows in the bag.

longListPairs.label: Pick-your-colours page from (pairs)
longListPairs.help: When the combo product page is on “Auto”, a rule that makes more pairs than this uses the pick-your-colours page (P2) instead of the pair page (P1).

previewCount.label: Combos shown in the preview step
previewCount.help: The "Make a combo" preview shows this many first, then "Show all".

repeatGuardMs.label: Double-tap guard (milliseconds)
repeatGuardMs.help: The same set added again within this time counts once: one tap is one set.

followPriceChanges.label: Sets in bags move to a new combo price
followPriceChanges.help: When you change a combo price, sets already in bags take the new price and the bag says so. A combo that has ended keeps the price it was added at.

background.label: Set photo background
background.help: The one house background behind every set photo made from the piece photos.

widthPx.label: Set photo width (pixels)
widthPx.help: The size the set photo is made at; the image service makes the smaller sizes.

heightPx.label: Set photo height (pixels)
heightPx.help: With the width, the shape of the set photo.

format.label: Set photo file type
format.help: WebP is smaller; JPEG works everywhere.

defaultDays.label: Combo report looks back (days)
defaultDays.help: The window the combo report opens with.

topCount.label: Best combos listed in the report
topCount.help: How many best-selling combos and colour pairs the report lists.
